output.reason: [ev-dea2079e5dc4] lists this under Breaking Changes. It says only that earlier chart values enabled exceptions in all namespaces by default (CVE-2024-48921) and that users relying on this "will be impacted"; it does not give the new default or say what happens to existing PolicyExceptions. The proposed statement says exceptions "stop applying outside the namespaces they configure," but nothing in the evidence supports that. If existing PolicyExceptions are no longer honoured, the kind would be action-eligible (setting-ignored/workload-failure), not behavior-change. The rendered diffs show only CRD and Service changes, not the chart values or controller-argument diff ([ev-b8120a2bb840] only removes the v2alpha1 version), so we need the values.yaml / rendered controller-flag diff showing the old and new exception defaults to settle the consequence kind.
